voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Luna found Cheeto in a little cage at the end of the palace. The moment she opened it, he leapt into her arms.

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: But the two big guards spotted them.

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Cheeto wiggled his floppy ears as hard as he could — Bzzzzt! A buzzy zap zinged through the air. The guards' clanky armour locked up tight — then they wobbled, yawned a big sleepy yawn, and flopped over, snoring like babies. Luna laughed. Then she turned into a tiger again, scooped Cheeto onto her back, and ran for the launch pad, where a shiny rocket was waiting. Up, up, up — Whoosh! The rocket roared into space, away from the palace, all the way home to Mum.
